common.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.

addMenu.title: Add to your closet
addMenu.empty: Nothing can be added yet. More options arrive with the next update.

home.title: Welcome to your closet
home.message: Add a few clothes and build an outfit, and today's look will appear here.

closet.title: Your closet is empty
closet.message: This is where all your clothes live. Photograph a piece to get started.

outfits.title: No outfits yet
outfits.message: Combine pieces from your closet into outfits and see them on you.

calendar.title: Nothing planned
calendar.message: Plan what to wear and keep a log of what you wore each day.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.heightInvalid: This does not look like a height. Check it or leave it empty.

backup.exportFailed: The backup could not be created.
backup.importConfirmMessage: Everything currently in the app will be replaced by the contents of the backup. This cannot be undone.
backup.importInvalid: This file is not a Closet backup. Nothing was changed.
backup.importNewer: This backup comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app and try again.

ai.title: AI provider keys
ai.intro: AI features use your own provider accounts. Keys are stored only in this device's keychain and are never included in backups.

anthropic.name: Anthropic Claude
anthropic.purpose: Tags clothes from photos and styles outfits.

ai.rejected: The provider rejected this key. Check that it was copied completely and is still active.
ai.testFailed: The provider could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
ai.removeConfirmMessage: Features that use this provider will stop working until you add a key again.
ai.keyNeededMessage: This feature uses {{provider}}. Add your key in Settings to use it.

onboarding.welcomeMessage: Photograph your clothes, put outfits together and see them on yourself. A few questions first, so the app can dress you.
onboarding.genderMessage: This helps with outfit renders and suggestions. All clothing categories stay available whatever you choose.
onboarding.bodyTypeTitle: Which shape is closest to yours?
onboarding.bodyTypeMessage: Used only as a hint when rendering outfits on you.
onboarding.saveFailed: Your profile could not be saved. Please try again.

avatar.title: Your photo
avatar.guidance: Stand straight facing the camera in good light, in fitted clothes, with your whole body from head to feet in the frame. Ask someone to take it or use a timer.
avatar.removeConfirmMessage: The photo is deleted from this device. Outfit renders will ask for a new one.
avatar.privacy: Your photo stays on this device. It is sent to the image provider only when you ask for an outfit render.
avatar.denied: Closet has no access to the camera or your photos. You can allow it in the system settings.

issue.noPerson: No person was found in this photo. Outfit renders need a clear photo of you.
issue.severalPeople: There is more than one person in this photo. Renders work best with only you in it.
issue.cutOff: Part of your body seems to be outside the frame. Renders work best when you are visible from head to feet.
issue.tooSmall: You are quite small in this photo. Standing closer to the camera gives better renders.
